title: Javelin and Sculpture
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Creative Arts and Sports; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Arts and Sports teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Throwing only in a cleared field with a teacher; carving with safe tools. Questions ask for materials, order and safety.

skills.key_step: The child names carving materials (soft wood, bamboo), the throwing phases in order (grip and carry, approach, cross-step, delivery, recovery) and the safety rules.

floor.question: Which way do you cut when carving?

representations: a field with a marked zone
steps: Grip and carry above the shoulder.
Deliver, then recover behind the line.

board.do: Write the five phases mixed up.

misconceptions.ask: Which material suits carving a javelin?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what a knife can shape: soft wood and bamboo, not iron.

misconceptions.ask: Which phase comes first in a javelin throw?
misconceptions.repair: Walk through the phases slowly with a stick: grip, run, cross-step, throw, recover.
Show the point and the distance it flies; mark the safe zone.

misconceptions.ask: When may you collect your javelin?
misconceptions.repair: Practise the signal: throw, wait, collect together.

checks.question: Which material is good for carving a javelin?
What is the last phase of a javelin throw?
